explanation: At D2 it is almost always 10 (9 after about trial 85, and 6-8 after a rare transition late in the episode). At D1 and GO it falls steadily through the episode, from about 8-9 in trials 0-15 to about 7-8 around trial 40, 5-6 around trial 70 and 0-2 after trial 90; GO sits about 1-2 above D1 later on, and D1 is about 1-3 higher after an unrewarded trial than after a rewarded one.
